hypothesis: Source failures after raw/clipped C1-prior residuals motivate directly classifying actual RGB appearance with a broadly pretrained frozen encoder; no C1 score/prior input.

features.input: Exact existing uint8 RGB96 and bool valid96 at immutable q/L
features.resize: Direct224x224 bilinear,align_corners=False,antialias=True; not the standard resize256/center224 recipe
features.output: Per-scale L2-normalized512 descriptors + full and central valid fractions

data.source: Exact V102 immutable bindings, V96 public real controls plus V99 synthetic
data.availability: Reuse immutable factual source-query availability; include unavailable known rows in U/recall and selector safe0
data.development_exposure: Source VAL repeatedly used for development; not a blind-test claim

fit.sampler: Exact V102 external adapter sampler seed205, balanced32D32E;4old+4new matchedtriplets plus fixed source quotas
fit.loss: Available known D/E BCE + .25*relu(2-(z_cover-z_sham)) on paired valid controls
fit.selector: Equal mean BCE of exact8 nonempty sourceVAL cohorts; strict earliest minimum; evaluate0 and every100updates
fit.between_arm_selection: Single prospective candidate; no sweep or restart after optimizer update

source_gates.empty_required_cohort: No fit; preserve actual metadata; no fallback or omitted cohort

admission: Select checkpoint by sourceBCE first, then admit only if all12 unchanged external source gates pass. No current inference on source gate failure.
